required_findings.problem: The only known analytic estimator fixture asserts frequency/radius error and abs(complex_amplitude)>0. It never checks recovered complex-amplitude scale or the frame4096/global-demodulation phase convention. Half-window diagnostics compare amplitude magnitudes, not known phase truth. No two-component/nuisance fixture exercises leakage or bias. These tests can pass with a nonzero but wrongly scaled/rotated amplitude even though the reused modal comparison imposes abs(candidateAmplitude/referenceAmplitude−1)<=0.005.
required_findings.why_material: Reference-self comparison is tautological for a common estimator and a wrong-note contrast does not validate absolute amplitude/phase reconstruction. The intended new finite calibration applicability needs the specific amplitude/time-origin and mixture controls requested in the plan. Existing public code identity alone does not validate its new signal/center/window use or supply calibrated uncertainty.
